title: Expressing genes in Saccharomyces cerevisiae
author: Jaclyn Winter
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8gchtsw
materials: Culture conditions for S. cerevisiae ZXM144

steps.title: Prepare YPDE agar plates
steps.instruction: Make YPDE agar containing per litre: 10 g yeast extract, 20 g peptone, 20 g dextrose, 40 mg ergosterol (add 4 mL of a 10 mg/mL stock dissolved 1:1 in Triton X‑100:EtOH after autoclaving and cooling), 20 g agar; adjust pH to 5.3. Autoclave, cool, add ergosterol solution, pour plates.

steps.title: Maintain ZXM144 strain
steps.instruction: Streak Saccharomyces cerevisiae ZXM144 on the YPDE plates and incubate at room temperature. Re‑streak every 2–4 weeks to keep cultures sterile.

steps.title: Initiate starter cultures
steps.instruction: From a freshly streaked plate, pick single colonies and inoculate 3 mL YPDE broth per culture. Grow at 28–30 °C with 250 rpm shaking for 48 h.

steps.title: Scale up culture for competence
steps.instruction: Transfer 0.5 mL of each 3 mL starter into 50 mL YPDE broth in a sterile 500 mL flask. Incubate at 28–30 °C with 220 rpm shaking for 15 h.

steps.title: Harvest and wash cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the 50 mL culture at 3 200 × g for 5 min; keep the largest pellet. Resuspend pellet in 25 mL wash buffer (1.2 M sorbitol, 0.1 M potassium phosphate, pH 7.5) by gentle mixing, then centrifuge again at 3 200 × g for 5 min.

steps.title: Resuspend cells in LiOAc‑PEG buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the washed pellet in 3.55 mL freshly prepared LiOAc‑PEG transformation buffer containing 0.1 M LiOAc, 280 µg/mL single‑stranded salmon sperm DNA, and 33 % PEG (Mn 3,350). This suspension is the competent‑cell stock.

steps.title: Transform cells with plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: For each transformation, mix 200 µL competent‑cell suspension with 1–5 µg plasmid DNA (maximum 5 µL volume). Vortex 1 s at max speed, incubate at 30 °C for 1 h (vortex 1 s every 15 min). Heat‑shock at 42 °C for 10 min, then plate the entire mixture on selective media.

steps.title: Prepare SCE dropout plates
steps.instruction: Prepare synthetic complete plus ergosterol (SCE) dropout agar per litre: 6 g succinic acid, 5 g KOH, 20 g dextrose, 40 mg ergosterol (add 4 mL of the 10 mg/mL stock dissolved 1:1 in Triton X‑100:EtOH after autoclaving and cooling), 20 g agar, pH 5.3; make 900 mL, autoclave. After cooling, add 100 mL filter‑sterilized yeast nitrogen base plus all amino acids except those required for auxotrophic selection. Pour plates and incubate at 28–30 °C until colonies are large enough for picking.

steps.title: Amplify mFPS N144W by PCR
steps.instruction: Set up a 20 µL PCR with 0.5 U Takara PrimeSTAR HS DNA polymerase, 20 pmol each of primers 5’ NotI GgFPS and 3’ SpeI GgFPS, and template plasmid DNA. Run under conditions appropriate for a 1 134 bp product.

steps.title: Purify PCR product from gel
steps.instruction: Run 10 µL of the PCR reaction on a 1 % agarose gel stained with SYBR® Safe. Excise the 1 134 bp band and purify using the Zymoclean™ Gel DNA Recovery Kit, eluting in 30 µL H₂O.

steps.title: Digest insert and vector
steps.instruction: Take 5 µL of the purified PCR product and digest overnight with NotI‑HF and SpeI‑HF (NEB). Purify the digested insert with the Zymo DNA Clean & Concentrator™ Kit, eluting in 20 µL H₂O. Separately, double‑digest the XURA vector with the same enzymes.

steps.title: Ligate insert into XURA vector
steps.instruction: Ligate the NotI/SpeI‑digested mFPS N144W insert with the equally digested XURA vector for 4 h at room temperature using T4 DNA Ligase (NEB). Total ligation volume is 10 µL.

steps.title: Transform ligation into DH10β cells
steps.instruction: Add half of the 10 µL ligation mix to DH10β competent E. coli cells, perform heat‑shock transformation, and plate on LB agar containing 100 mg/L ampicillin.

steps.title: Screen colonies and verify construct
steps.instruction: Identify positive clones by colony PCR using the same 5’ NotI GgFPS and 3’ SpeI GgFPS primers. Mini‑prep plasmid DNA from PCR‑positive colonies, verify insert size by restriction digest, and confirm sequence (in‑frame, error‑free). The verified clone is named pSBW02.

steps.title: Insert fmsB into pSBW02 vector
steps.instruction: Amplify fmsB using primers 5’ BamHI 3544‑STS Start and 3’ XmaI 3544‑STS Stop with pSBW01 as template. Digest the PCR product and pSBW02 with BamHI and XmaI, purify, ligate, transform into DH10β cells, and select on LB‑Amp as before. Verify the final construct by colony PCR, miniprep, restriction analysis, and sequencing.
